turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting coolant system diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the initial coolant checks. First, check the coolant level against the tank minimum and maximum marks. Then assess the coolant colour and odour for any signs of contamination. Finally, check the refractometer reading against the specified concentration range.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the coolant level against the tank minimum and maximum marks. 2. Assess coolant colour and odour for signs of contamination. 3. Check refractometer reading against the specified concentration range.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The coolant level and concentration look fine, but I'm noticing a lot of foam buildup on the surface of the tank that wasn't there yesterday.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Initial checks complete. Coolant level is within marks, colour looks normal, and I've got the refractometer reading recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the coolant level against the tank minimum and maximum marks. 2. Assess coolant colour and odour for signs of contamination. 3. Check refractometer reading against the specified concentration range.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do you observe severe contamination such as tramp oil, biological growth, or discolouration?

ground_truth.node_text: Severe contamination: tramp oil, biological growth or discolouration?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the coolant appears clean with no visible oil contamination, growth, or unusual discolouration.

ground_truth.node_text: Severe contamination: tramp oil, biological growth or discolouration?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the concentration within the specified Brix range?

ground_truth.node_text: Concentration within specified Brix range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the concentration reading falls within the target range after applying the correction factor.

ground_truth.node_text: Concentration within specified Brix range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the pH within the acceptable range?

ground_truth.node_text: pH within acceptable range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the pH reading is outside the acceptable range and needs correction.

ground_truth.node_text: pH within acceptable range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Add pH correction agent according to the dosing table.

ground_truth.node_text: Add pH correction agent per dosing table

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: pH correction agent added per the dosing table.

ground_truth.node_text: Add pH correction agent per dosing table

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Read the inline flow meter display with the coolant pump running at normal operating speed. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare it against the minimum required flow rate for the machine specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Read the inline flow meter display with the coolant pump running at normal operating speed. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare against the minimum required flow rate for the machine specification. If no inline meter is fitted, use the timed bucket method at the main return line and calculate flow rate from volume and elapsed time.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Flow meter reading recorded and compared against specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Read the inline flow meter display with the coolant pump running at normal operating speed. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare against the minimum required flow rate for the machine specification. If no inline meter is fitted, use the timed bucket method at the main return line and calculate flow rate from volume and elapsed time.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the coolant flow rate within the specified range?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant flow rate within specified range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the flow rate meets the minimum requirement for this machine.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant flow rate within specified range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the coolant return temperature within the operating range?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within operating range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The coolant return temp gauge is reading normal, but I'm seeing excessive foam and bubbles in the reservoir sight glass—looks like there might be air getting into the system somewhere.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the return temperature is running higher than the maximum permitted value.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within operating range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: inspect the heat exchanger coil surfaces for dust or scale deposits, check the coolant pump outlet pressure against the rated value, and verify all coolant nozzles are unobstructed and correctly directed.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the heat exchanger coil surfaces for dust or scale deposits. 2. Check the coolant pump outlet pressure against the rated value. 3. Verify all coolant nozzles are unobstructed and correctly directed.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Hey, before I continue with this, do you know if the PM schedule for the hydraulic system got updated last week? I need to check when that's due.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Heat exchanger, pump pressure, and nozzle checks completed.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the heat exchanger coil surfaces for dust or scale deposits. 2. Check the coolant pump outlet pressure against the rated value. 3. Verify all coolant nozzles are unobstructed and correctly directed.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Shut off coolant flow and remove each nozzle from the manifold. Hold each nozzle against a light source and inspect the orifice for swarf blockage or mineral deposits. Clean or replace nozzles as needed.

ground_truth.node_text: Shut off coolant flow and remove each nozzle from the manifold. Hold each nozzle against a light source and inspect the orifice for swarf blockage or mineral deposits. Blocked nozzles should be soaked in descaler for 10 minutes then cleared with a wire of the correct gauge. Replace nozzles where the orifice shows erosion or enlargement beyond the nominal drill size.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All nozzles removed and inspected against light source. Cleaning completed where needed.

ground_truth.node_text: Shut off coolant flow and remove each nozzle from the manifold. Hold each nozzle against a light source and inspect the orifice for swarf blockage or mineral deposits. Blocked nozzles should be soaked in descaler for 10 minutes then cleared with a wire of the correct gauge. Replace nozzles where the orifice shows erosion or enlargement beyond the nominal drill size.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all coolant nozzles unobstructed and correctly directed?

ground_truth.node_text: All coolant nozzles unobstructed and correctly directed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I found a couple of nozzles with partial blockages that need attention.

ground_truth.node_text: All coolant nozzles unobstructed and correctly directed?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Unblock or replace the blocked coolant nozzles.

ground_truth.node_text: Unblock or replace blocked coolant nozzles

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Blocked nozzles cleared and reinstalled on the manifold.

ground_truth.node_text: Unblock or replace blocked coolant nozzles

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: With the coolant pump running, observe the chip conveyor return flow inlet at the sump end. Verify that coolant is flowing visibly back to the sump through the return channel.

ground_truth.node_text: With the coolant pump running, observe the chip conveyor return flow inlet at the sump end. Coolant should be flowing visibly back to the sump through the return channel. Absence of return flow indicates a blocked return strainer or a conveyor drive fault; check the return strainer basket and clear any accumulated chip material.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Observing the chip conveyor return flow now with pump running.

ground_truth.node_text: With the coolant pump running, observe the chip conveyor return flow inlet at the sump end. Coolant should be flowing visibly back to the sump through the return channel. Absence of return flow indicates a blocked return strainer or a conveyor drive fault; check the return strainer basket and clear any accumulated chip material.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is coolant recovery from the chip conveyor operating correctly?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant recovery from chip conveyor operating correctly?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the return flow is restricted. Not seeing proper flow back to the sump.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant recovery from chip conveyor operating correctly?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Clear the chip conveyor return tray and check the drain ports.

ground_truth.node_text: Clear chip conveyor return tray and check drain ports

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Return tray cleared and drain ports checked. Removed accumulated chip material.

ground_truth.node_text: Clear chip conveyor return tray and check drain ports

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. Record the maximum reading.

ground_truth.node_text: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. Record the maximum reading and compare against the maximum permitted sediment depth in the sump cleaning schedule. Sediment exceeding 25 millimetres requires immediate sump pump out and cleaning.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing a thick oily film floating on top of the coolant surface here, not really sediment at the bottom. Should I be concerned about that or just focus on the settled material?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Sediment depth measured at all three locations. Maximum reading recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. Record the maximum reading and compare against the maximum permitted sediment depth in the sump cleaning schedule. Sediment exceeding 25 millimetres requires immediate sump pump out and cleaning.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the sump sediment depth below 20 millimetres?

ground_truth.node_text: Sump sediment depth below 20 mm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the sediment depth exceeds 20 millimetres at multiple measurement points.

ground_truth.node_text: Sump sediment depth below 20 mm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Schedule a sump clean, drain, scrub, and refill.

ground_truth.node_text: Schedule sump clean, drain, scrub and refill

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Sump cleaning scheduled in the maintenance system.

ground_truth.node_text: Schedule sump clean, drain, scrub and refill

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform a system function test. Run a machine cycle and verify coolant delivery.

ground_truth.node_text: System function test, run machine cycle, verify coolant delivery

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Function test complete. Machine cycle ran successfully and coolant delivery verified.

ground_truth.node_text: System function test, run machine cycle, verify coolant delivery

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the coolant data, refractometer reading, and update the service record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log coolant data, refractometer reading and update service record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All data logged and service record updated in the system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log coolant data, refractometer reading and update service record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Coolant system diagnostic procedure complete. Return the machine to normal production status.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, returning machine to production.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
